title: Header: Shop by Brand dropdown
head: nav-brand-dropdown-2026-09-16
body:
The header only rendered top-level menu links, so nested items (Shop by Brand → 6 breweries) were invisible.

- Desktop: parent items with children render as a `<details>` dropdown panel (keyboard accessible; closes on outside click / Escape; one open at a time).
- Mobile drawer: parent shown as a small label with children indented beneath.
- Active link/parent highlighted via `aria-current`.

Menu itself was updated in Shopify admin: Home · Shop All Beer · Shop by Brand (6) · Build Your Own Box · Contact.
